_comment: Bound for the end-to-end character-error-rate check (tests/test_e2e.py). While bound_is_placeholder is true, cer_bound is NOT a measurement: it is a loose sanity ceiling. To record the real baseline, run the CLI on the sample PDF, run `python ocr_eval.py <pdf>`, then set cer_bound slightly above the measured total CER, set bound_is_placeholder to false and fill in `measured`.

harness_smoke_test_on_substitute_pdf._comment: NOT the baseline: the 21-page sample is not on this machine. This only shows the harness runs end to end on a real PDF.
harness_smoke_test_on_substitute_pdf.pdf: a digital-born Traditional Chinese proposal PDF (not the sample)

stand_in_measurements._comment: NOT the baseline and NOT the sample: a smoke measurement of both Readers on a different, digital-born Traditional Chinese proposal PDF, pages 3-12, with `python ocr_eval.py` (pdf_ocr.py defaults). The sample's baseline per Reader is still to be measured.
stand_in_measurements.pdf: a digital-born Traditional Chinese proposal PDF (not the sample)
